source: v285 audited independent option bank; all courses are consumed development cases

arms.baseline: frozen SONIC + fixed 0.95 m acquisition, lateral navigation gain 0
arms.candidate: same motor + causal proportional ball-relative lateral navigation gain 0.8 clipped to +/-0.2 m/s until root-ball forward gap <=0.95 m

procedure: For each course and arm, rerun an independent parent and one independent late-swing episode under the same new runner and source hash. Four A6000 workers. Audit physical, command, action and source receipts; no batched causal labels.
primary_gate: Candidate must reduce >4 m lateral out-of-play from four to at most two in baseline-out group, keep all four protection controls high quality, and not add any out-of-play in the other seven courses.
safety_gate: Candidate must not reduce total clean foot-only contacts, must have no pelvis <0.65 m, and all traces must pass independent audit.
